_note: Per-study assertions drawn from the established record: PR #117 cross-study metadata, PR #91 GSE301119 support census, PR #92 GSE311359 BIN1 STOP, PR #86 GSE254205 V2, PR #94 GSE240609 identity audit, and the PR #77 physical recovery work. These are inputs to the inventory producer, not conclusions it derives. ETL status describes whether a producer has consumed the physical bytes; biological estimability describes what independent units exist; outcome exposure describes whether any response value has been read. None implies another.

GSE175721.independent_units: undetermined; no per-cell perturbation identity exists
GSE175721.limitation: 14-guide FASTA and matrices are in hand; the depositor-described cell-to-guide TSV was never deposited at series, SuperSeries or sample level, and the unenriched BAM carries roughly 4 vector-scaffold reads per 400,000 unplaced reads, far too few to assign about 10,000 cells. No join may be invented.
GSE175721.blocking_missing_source: authentic per-cell guide assignment TSV, a Seurat object carrying assignments, or genuine guide-enrichment reads

GSE178317.independent_units: 1 pooled biological preparation split across 4 10x capture wells; wells are technical, not biological, replicates
GSE178317.limitation: Guide identity recovered from SRA plus Supplementary Table 5; 11,775 of 58,302 cells assigned across 39 targets; 39/39 knocked down. Capture-well spread is technical. Day-8 has zero directly overlapping targets with the 31-target GSE335887 screens and must not determine a universal cross-experiment predictor.

GSE240609.independent_units: 1 physical sample per 2x2 design cell, 4 total
GSE240609.limitation: Source RNA is CD11b-purified microglia recovered after neuron coculture, not unfractionated coculture. Descriptive genotype contrasts only; no factorial population-level standard error and no cell-autonomous claim. V2 effect table physically produced, so earlier UNOPENED_RESERVED label is unsafe without a separate audited exposure ledger.

GSE241858.independent_units: 2 independent clones per genotype, with within-clone replicates grouped beneath the clone
GSE241858.limitation: Bulk genotype by LPS/IFN-gamma design. This is not a CRISPR perturbation study and must not be labelled one. Clone is the biological unit; within-clone replicates are averaged before any contrast.

GSE254205.independent_units: 9 bulk samples (3 per condition); technical/biological replicate provenance limited by original sample design
GSE254205.limitation: 58,395 genes assayed, 36,117 detected anywhere, 22,278 assayed-undetected rather than structurally missing. The snRNA h5ad, ATAC and LD-sort assets are unprocessed and require metadata-first handling with an exposure declaration before any previously unread effect is inspected. Drug-induced change is not evidence of disease rescue.

GSE293118.independent_units: HMC3 immortalized line; guide-level support varies, and single-guide SYVN1 supplies no independent guide variance
GSE293118.limitation: Six directly measurable target engagements are verified with legitimate multiplet filtering and non-targeting controls. The remaining 77 noncoding or unmatched targets have no authenticated direct cis-target assignment; no nearest-gene mapping may be invented.
GSE293118.blocking_missing_source: authenticated cis-target assignment for the 77 noncoding or unmatched elements

GSE301119.independent_units: 2 independent primary-macrophage donors; CRISPRa HEXA carries only one guide per donor, so its guide variance is not estimable
GSE301119.limitation: CRISPRi and CRISPRa must stay separate strata. Cells are not donors. Two donors permit only limited transport inference. A SeuratObject 5 reader is required; Seurat 4 accessors can silently misread Assay5. Donor-aware effect matrices executed but independently reproducing FC signs, normalization and donor-specific matrices remains pending. Do not use CRISPRi-down/CRISPRa-up signs as self-validation.

GSE311359.independent_units: 7 samples; guide-level independence is broken for BIN1 and unconfirmed for the remainder pending a feature-row-keyed rebuild
GSE311359.limitation: Original 3 BIN1 capture rows share display name; unique source feature IDs BIN1_enh_1, BIN1_enh_2, BIN1_enh_2_AS resolve identity, NOT causal cis targeting or guide protospacer validation. Old V1 BIN1 effects are invalid; reaggregate every target with feature row ID, independently check 82 others, and publish V2 before any promotion.
